answer_1.quote: We also show applicability of CoSe-Co in improving performance on paraphrase generation task ( §4.5). ... We fine-tune T5-base to generate annotated paraphrase given a sentence as input on MRPC dataset. Generated paths are appended as string to input.
answer_1.outputs: Generated commonsense knowledge paths (sequences of entities and relations) and paraphrased sentences

answer_2.quote: We evaluate generated paths on relevance, diversity and novelty ... We estimate Relevance by treating each triple ... BLEU score between them. ... For paraphrase generation we report BLEU-4, METEOR, ROUGE-L, CIDEr and SPICE.

answer_4.quote: We presented evaluators with questions from CSQA dataset with corresponding commonsense paths generated by CoSe-Co and PGQA in an anonymized manner to compare the generative commonsense methods. We asked them to compare the paths based on their contextual relevance with the complete sentence and classify them into one of three categories ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to judge each generated path for contextual relevance to the question/sentence and select: 1) CoSe-Co better, 2) PGQA better, 3) both similar.
